verdict.rationale: Braintrust supports data residency only through its self-hosted deployment. You run the data-storage infrastructure in your own cloud account and region, while Braintrust provides the managed UI, auth and updates. Choosing a region therefore means operating your own infrastructure rather than picking a residency option on the managed service. Missing for 10: region selection for the managed SaaS (e.g., EU/US hosted regions), documentation of supported regions, independent or hands-on confirmation of residency guarantees.
